t002_decision_summary.owner_action_execution_purpose: owner-confirmed candidate review workflow commands affect review workflow state only
t002_decision_summary.command_taxonomy: allowed safe review command taxonomy includes acknowledge, request more evidence, defer, reject, quarantine, owner note/rationale metadata, and bounded non-canon review status updates; forbidden taxonomy includes apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, raw artifact persistence, runtime extraction, model calls, generated prose, and training data
t002_decision_summary.request_boundary: future requests carry project_id, queue_entry_id or candidate_id, action_type, actor or owner confirmation marker, explicit confirmation where needed, owner_note/rationale, expected current review status/version, and evidence/provenance/source locator preservation requirements, with no payload that can directly write canon or generate prose
t002_decision_summary.response_boundary: future responses report accepted/rejected and updated review workflow state only, immutable candidate linkage, no canon mutation result, no apply-promotion result, no raw artifact result, warnings that queue/candidate/review status is not canon, and fail closed errors
t002_decision_summary.frontend_workflow: future frontend workflow separates read-only candidate details from command controls, requires explicit owner action, displays candidate-only/no-canon warnings, preserves evidence/provenance/source locator context, exposes no prose-generation controls, and does not silently execute commands
t002_decision_summary.t003_expected_red_contract: PHASE8-IMPL-016-T003 created tests/test_writer_assistant_review_action_command_routes_contract.py for the review command owner-action candidate review route POST /api/projects/{project_id}/review-queue/{queue_entry_id}/actions; it covers mark_reviewed, request_more_evidence, defer, reject, quarantine, update_owner_note, set_review_status, forbidden apply_promotion, promote_candidate, write_memory, write_canon, persist_raw_artifact, run_extraction, run_booknlp, run_spacy, call_model, generate_prose, rewrite_prose, continue_scene, create_training_jsonl, fail closed malformed payloads, route separation, response boundary, no silent promotion, no apply-promotion, no memory/canon mutation, no raw artifact persistence, no runtime extraction, no model calls, and no generated prose
t002_decision_summary.t004_implementation_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-016-T004 implemented the minimal backend route/helper for POST /api/projects/{project_id}/review-queue/{queue_entry_id}/actions as response-only review workflow command acceptance/rejection; it accepts only mark_reviewed, request_more_evidence, defer, reject, quarantine, update_owner_note, and set_review_status, rejects forbidden commands and unsafe payloads fail closed, and does not implement apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, project truth mutation, raw artifact persistence, runtime extraction, model calls, generated prose, or training artifacts
t002_decision_summary.t005_implementation_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-016-T005 implemented the minimal frontend owner-action review workflow/surface for bounded review commands; it added a deterministic frontend helper for POST /api/projects/{project_id}/review-queue/{queue_entry_id}/actions, read-only candidate details separated from explicit owner action controls, candidate-only/no-canon warnings, evidence/provenance/source locator display and preservation, fail-closed unsupported command and missing-ID behavior, and no apply-promotion, memory/canon/project truth mutation, raw artifact persistence, runtime extraction, model calls, generated prose, or training artifacts
t002_decision_summary.t006_implementation_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-016-T006 added focused safety regression coverage proving the backend action route remains response-only review workflow state, forbidden commands and payload fields fail closed, frontend controls expose only allowed review workflow commands with explicit owner confirmation, candidate-only/no-canon/evidence/provenance/source locator warnings remain present, command payload construction excludes forbidden fields, and the targeted source boundary scan distinguishes rejected fixtures from implementation behavior without the earlier contradictory substring issue
t002_decision_summary.t007_closeout_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-016-T007 closed the parent as docs/status closeout only; confirmed tracked artifacts from T004/T005/T006; re-validated command route contract, frontend source tests, safety regression, review API contracts, and review queue storage plus candidate review gate regressions; confirmed no apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, raw persistence, runtime extraction, model calls, generated prose, or training artifacts; recommended PHASE8-IMPL-017 as next MVP-required parent ready/active pending T001 publication
